calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the window (P0 = Nov 20 close, P1 = Dec 4 close), that earnings fall before it, and on the scandal context. The factual dispute is NVDA's volatility level. Run 1 cites 30-day IV of 63-67%, but that reading includes the earnings event. Run 3 assumes 45-50%. With no web access I can't check post-earnings IV. A post-earnings crush to ~50-55% is the likeliest state, and implied vol tends to overstate realized vol, so my SD sits between the runs' implicit assumptions. That lands at ~19pp, close to Runs 1-2. Escape mass is a judgment call: the runs put 3% to 6% on each side. I chose 4% per side because a spread over ±15pp needs a roughly 2-sigma move, and in a scandal regime that is plausible (e.g. a CEO named, or new revelations). The median is a judgment call; all runs are at 0-0.3 and I see no evidence to move it. Market check: no matching contract exists. The Manifold big-tech-vs-BTC market is unrelated (different assets, horizon and metric).
